raw_network_captures.description: Raw network-request captures from Playwright route interception on 4 SPAs

sites.synthetic: 250 transitions, 10 trajectories x 25 steps, 8-state deterministic SPA
sites.multistep_form: 120 transitions, 10 trajectories x 12 steps, 4-step checkout wizard
sites.wizard: 32 transitions (partial capture), 10 trajectories x 12 steps, 4-step wizard

pmi_results.description: PMI computation results including per-site metrics, permutation tests, and alpha sensitivity

pmi_computation.description: PMI computation with Laplace smoothing, permutation tests, and alpha sensitivity analysis

capture_script.description: Playwright capture script for all local SPAs with route interception

synthetic_server.description: Synthetic SPA positive control server (8 states, 4 actions)

dashboard_server.description: Dashboard SPA server (4 tabs with distinct API endpoints)

multistep_form_server.description: Multi-step form SPA server (4-step checkout, same API calls per step)

wizard_server.description: Wizard SPA server (4-step wizard with server-side step tracking)

methods.state_discretization: SHA-256(endpoint_path + HTTP_method + status_code + request_body_fragment[:200]) per request; sorted tuple of per-request hashes for transition state
methods.pmi_formula: PMI(s, a, s') = log2[P(s' | s, a) / P(s' | s)] with Laplace smoothing alpha=1.0
methods.permutation_test: 1000 permutations of action labels within trajectories, one-sided p-value
methods.within_url_classification: URL path before action equals URL path after action (hash-based, not label-based)
